name: Broken One
notes: Encounter summary from the printed 3.5 edition.

statBlock.name: Broken One
statBlock.otherStatistics: Initiative −1. AC 15 (−1 Dex, +6 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 15. Base attack +2, grapple +5. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +0, Will +5. Climb +8, Hide +4, Listen +5, Spot +5. Multiattack. Any land or underground. Solitary, gangs of 2–5, or packs of 6–11. Standard treasure. Usually neutral evil. Advances at 4–6 HD (Medium) or 7–9 HD (Large).
statBlock.description: Scarred and mismatched limbs show where magic, surgery, or a curse remade this creature.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +5 melee (1d4+3).
Full attack. Two slams +5 melee (1d4+3 each).
sections.Choose two powers:
Each broken one has two of these powers. For a quick encounter, use Damage Reduction and Improved Grab.
Damage Reduction (Su). DR 10/magic.
Extra Limb (Ex). Add one slam to the full attack and gain Multiattack.
Frenzy (Ex), 1/day. Gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and Constitution and take −2 AC until the broken one or its opponent dies.
Fluid Body (Su). Flatten and pass through any opening that water could pass through.
Improved Grab (Ex). A successful slam allows a free grapple attempt without provoking an attack of opportunity.
Inhuman Strength (Ex). Add 4 to Strength and raise melee attack and damage by 2.
sections.Tactics and languages: It tends to charge without concern for its own safety. It understands the languages it knew before transformation but speaks them with difficulty. A specimen made from an animal often speaks its creator’s language.

ruleNotes: Both the printed base stat line and Extra Limb list Multiattack. If using Extra Limb, apply the feat once. The two powers suggested for a quick encounter are a table choice.

name: Dread Doppelganger
notes: Encounter summary from the printed 3.5 edition.

statBlock.name: Dread Doppelganger
statBlock.otherStatistics: Initiative +1. AC 17 (+1 Dex, +6 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 16. Base attack +4, grapple +6. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +6. Bluff +12, Disguise +12, Listen +11, Sense Motive +6, Spot +8. Alertness, Dodge. Any land or underground, especially Paridon. Solitary, pair, or clan of 4–12. Double standard treasure. Usually neutral evil. Advances by class.
statBlock.description: Clans replace members of wealthy households one at a time. A cornered impostor may fake its death to keep the rest of the clan hidden.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +6 melee (1d6+2).
Full attack. Two slams +6 melee (1d6+2 each). It can instead use the weapons of its assumed identity.
sections.Traits:
Change Shape (Su). Assume the shape of any Small or Medium humanoid and keep it indefinitely.
Detect Thoughts (Su). Works continuously as the spell at caster level 18th, Will DC 14 negates. Suppress or resume it as a free action.
Glamer (Su). As a free action, change the look and texture of an object it carries without changing its underlying material. The object reverts at a separation of 5 ft. or more.
Immune to sleep and charm effects.
sections.Disguise checks: Bluff and Disguise receive a +4 racial bonus. Add another +10 circumstance bonus to Disguise in an assumed shape. When it can read the observer’s mind, add +4 circumstance to both Bluff and Disguise.

ruleNotes: The skill paragraph calls Change Shape “disguise self,” but the stat block lists Change Shape and Glamer. At the table, apply the +10 bonus to an assumed shape.

name: Ermordenung
notes: Encounter summary from the printed 3.5 edition.

statBlock.name: Ermordenung
statBlock.otherStatistics: Initiative +8. AC 15 (+4 Dex, +1 padded armor), touch 14, flat-footed 11. Base attack +3, grapple +7. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +10, Will +4. Bluff +12, Diplomacy +12, Escape Artist +7, Gather Information +10, Hide +10, Intimidate +8, Listen +8, Move Silently +11, Sense Motive +12, Spot +12, Use Magic Device +8. Dodge, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes. Three potions of cure moderate wounds. Solitary or pair in Borca. Standard treasure. Usually lawful evil. Advances by class.
statBlock.description: Ivana Boritsi’s assassin passes among Borca’s nobility and can poison a target through bare skin.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Unarmed strike +7 melee (1d3+4 nonlethal plus poison) or +1 dagger at +8 melee (1d4+5). Sneak attack +2d6 when eligible.
Toxic Touch (Ex). An unarmed strike against bare skin ignores the target’s natural armor. A foe striking the ermordenung unarmed is also exposed. Contact poison, Fortitude DC 15, initial and secondary damage 2d4 Constitution.
Kiss of Death (Ex). In combat, a successful grapple check delivers the same poison at Fortitude DC 19.
sections.Defenses: Evasion and uncanny dodge. Immune to poison except toxins from other ermordenung and poisons created by Ravenloft’s closed domain borders.

ruleNotes: This is the print’s 4th-level human rogue sample. The DCs follow the printed formula, 10 + half the creature’s HD + Constitution modifier, plus 4 for Kiss of Death. The sample’s weapon damage line gives the dagger no poison.

name: Gremishka
notes: Encounter summary from the printed 3.5 edition.

statBlock.name: Gremishka
statBlock.otherStatistics: Initiative +10. AC 18 (+2 size, +6 Dex), touch 18, flat-footed 12. Base attack +1, grapple −10. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +8, Will −1. Hide +18, Listen +4, Move Silently +8, Sleight of Hand +12, Spot +4, Tumble +10. Dodge, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse (bonus). Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision. Any land, often in darkness. Swarm of 20–40. Double standard treasure. Usually chaotic evil. Advances at 2–3 HD (Small).
statBlock.description: These nimble pests spring traps and leap onto intruders in packs.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +8 melee (1d2−3).
Full attack. Two claws +8 melee (1d2−3 each) and bite +3 melee (1d3−3).
Improved Grab (Ex). If both claws hit, attempt to grab. On success, the gremishka latches on and deals its bite damage automatically each round. Its target is not grappled but carries the gremishka’s 4 lb. Attacks from someone else deal damage to the gremishka first. Excess beyond its HP goes to the creature carrying it.
Swarm (Ex). Up to 20 gremishkas can attack and latch onto a Medium target in one round. Double that limit per size category larger or halve it per category smaller. Every four attached gremishkas add 1 to their combined bite damage.
sections.Bright light: Skitterish (Ex). Sudden bright light, such as from daylight, calls for a DC 15 Fear save. Ravenloft Fear save. Roll against the DC using Will and applicable fear adjustments. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked for 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Another failed Fear save escalates an existing fear effect by one step. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.
sections.Tactics and languages: Groups prefer dark ambush sites and often build traps. They speak Gremishka, and some understand human languages without speaking them.

ruleNotes: Apply the 3.5 minimum of 1 point of damage on a successful hit when the printed damage roll is 0 or lower.

name: Grim
notes: Encounter summary from the printed 3.5 edition.

statBlock.name: Grim
statBlock.speed: Dog 60 ft. (12 squares). Owl 10 ft. (2 squares), fly 90 ft. (average).
statBlock.otherStatistics: Initiative +10. AC 18 (+6 Dex, +2 natural), touch 16, flat-footed 12. Base attack +4, grapple +6. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +3. Listen +12, Sense Motive +14, Spot +15. Extra Turning, Improved Initiative, Multiattack. Solitary on any land. No treasure. Always neutral good. Advances at 5–8 HD (Medium) or 9–15 HD (Large).
statBlock.description: A black dog or horned owl keeps watch over the grave or shrine to which it is bound.

sections.Actions:
Dog attack or full attack. Bite +7 melee (2d6+3).
Owl attack. Claws +6 melee (1d4+2). Full attack adds bite +4 melee (1d6+2).
Frightful Presence (Ex). It howls or screeches when it first detects evil on its grounds and can repeat the howl at will as a standard action. Evil creatures within 30 ft. make a DC 15 Fear save. A success grants immunity to this grim’s Frightful Presence for one day.
Turning (Su). Turn or destroy evil undead and outsiders as a 9th-level cleric.
sections.Traits:
The grim chooses dog or owl form at dusk and retains it until dawn. Most statistics are shared across both forms. It fades in daylight, invisible and intangible, and returns fully healed at sunset. It never leaves its grounds and does not need food or sleep.
Detect Corruption (Su). It continually detects evil undead and outsiders within 60 ft. It has a 20% chance per failed powers check to detect corruption in other creatures.
DR 15/magic and spell resistance 16. Immune to necromantic effects. Magic circle against evil operates continuously at caster level 12th and cannot be suppressed. Sense Motive and Spot get a +4 racial bonus.
sections.Fear save: Ravenloft Fear save. Roll against the DC using Will and applicable fear adjustments. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked for 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Another failed Fear save escalates an existing fear effect by one step. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

ruleNotes: Touch and flat-footed AC follow from the listed Dexterity and natural armor bonuses. The book lists only total AC.

name: Impersonator
notes: Encounter summary from the printed 3.5 edition.

statBlock.name: Impersonator
statBlock.otherStatistics: Initiative +1. AC 12 (+1 size, +1 Dex), printed touch 11 and flat-footed 11. Base attack +3, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +5. Disguise +10, Listen +4, Spot +4. Skill Focus (Disguise). Temperate or warm marshes and underground. Solitary. Standard treasure. Always neutral evil. Advances at 6–8 HD (Medium) or 9–10 HD (Large).
statBlock.description: A pool the color of old blood can briefly take the shape of someone it has fed on.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Slam +5 melee (1d4).
Paralysis (Ex). A slam in natural form forces a DC 16 Fortitude save. Failure paralyzes the target as long as contact continues and for 1d4 rounds after it ends.
Blood Drain (Ex). Envelop a paralyzed creature and deal 1d4 Constitution damage per round without pain. The process does not wake an already sleeping victim.
sections.Traits:
Immune to paralysis, sleep, stunning, polymorphing, and critical hits.
Replication (Ex). Change shape as a standard action into a Small or Medium creature whose blood it has tasted. It typically has 3d4 forms ready and can keep a form for one hour per point of Constitution damage it inflicted on that victim by draining blood. Copy none of the target’s abilities. A copied weapon deals only 1d4 damage. Replication grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks. It understands simple ideas in the languages of past victims but cannot speak.

ruleNotes: The book prints touch AC 11 despite listing only +1 size and +1 Dexterity bonuses, which would normally give touch AC 12. It also prints grapple +3 for this Small creature. The encounter keeps the printed values.

name: Skin Thief
notes: Encounter summary from the printed 3.5 edition.

statBlock.name: Skin Thief
statBlock.otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC 15 (+3 Dex, +2 natural), touch 13, flat-footed 12. Base attack +2, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +5. Bluff +6, Disguise +5, Hide +6, Intimidate +6. Dodge. Any land or underground. Solitary, family of 3–6, or clan of 4–12. Double standard treasure. Usually chaotic evil. Advances by class.
statBlock.description: A stocky, shaggy shapeshifter slips into the skin of someone it killed and waits for that person’s friends.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +4 melee (1d6+2).
Full attack. Two claws +4 melee (1d6+2 each) and bite −1 melee (1d4+1 plus poison).
Poison (Ex). Injury, Fortitude DC 13, initial and secondary damage 1d6 Dexterity.
Skin Theft (Su). Use one full-round action to skin a humanoid it killed and another to put on the skin. It takes on the victim’s appearance and natural armor bonus, and gains +8 racial on Disguise, without acquiring memories or abilities. Whenever it takes damage, make a Reflex save at DC 10 + damage taken. Failure bursts the disguise.
sections.Tactics and languages: It lures isolated prey, then uses its bite or attacks with its clan. Its mixed dialect borrows from languages it has heard. A listener has a 5% chance per language they know of understanding the gist of any statement.
